results.detail: No visible defects such as cracks, corrosion, spalling, deformation, or leakage were detected in the image.

PHP 15000–120000, likely 35000. Assumes a single column with high-severity spalling. The low range covers minor patching, the likely range covers chipping, rebar treatment, and polymer-modified mortar repair over an estimated 0.5 sqm area, and the high range accounts for potential structural jacking and partial column replacement due to unseen core damage.

Assess the column and verify conditions to determine the appropriate repair strategy for the exposed reinforcement. High severity spalling with exposed reinforcement on a column requires professional engineering evaluation and site measurements before repair specifications can be finalized.

A structural inspection was conducted for the synthetic column. The overall computed risk score for the inspected element is 7.2 out of 10, categorizing the risk level as high. During the site assessment, concrete spalling was observed on one column, which has been identified as a synthetic fixture only. No measured data regarding structural strength, crack width, tilt, or settlement was supplied for this evaluation.
